full_judgment: 3. In the petition for review the main ground taken and which has also been argued by Dr. Rafiqur Rahman, learned Counsel for the petitioner, is that the appeal against acquittal before the High Court Division was barred by limitation of 557 days, but without proper explanation, the High Court Division condoned the delay and admitted the appeal causing serious injustice to the accused who was already acquitted upon a judgment which was not perverse on the face of it. The learned Counsel has argued that when a valuable right had accrued to the acquitted accused on the expiry of the period of limitation for filing the appeal, admission of the appeal without hearing the accused was improper since it interfered with his liberty. This question was raised before us at the time of hearing of the leave petition. But we found that the High Court Division having been satisfied with the ground for delay in filing the appeal, there was nothing for us to interfere with its discretion. We find no good reason to change our view.
